title: Coin Change
statement: Return the fewest coins that sum to `amount`. You have an unlimited supply of each coin in `coins`. Return -1 if the amount cannot be made.
hints: dp[x] is the fewest coins that make x.
dp[x] = 1 + min(dp[x - coin]) over coins that do not exceed x.
Initialize dp[0] to 0 and every other cell to a sentinel larger than any real answer. If the sentinel remains, return -1.

approaches.name: BFS on the remainder
approaches.explanation: Each edge subtracts one coin. The depth is the fewest coins.

editorial: This is unbounded knapsack where every item has weight equal to its value and the cost is the number of items. Filling amounts from 0 to amount, and trying every coin, enforces that a coin may be reused because smaller amounts are already solved. amount 0 needs 0 coins.

examples.explanation: Odd amounts cannot be made from twos.
